about_the_game:
Step into the slippers of 72-year old Oswald, the Maintenance man and resident of an apartment building that's now suddenly floating in the middle of the ocean.

You take it upon yourself to check in on all the residents leading you through a chaotic and surreal world where each apartment offers a unique story. Choose to get to know your neighbors and uncover the deep lore and hidden secrets or simply fulfil your duties.

The choice is yours. 

You are the maintanence man.

You must maintain. 

Strange and Surreal World: Your next door neighbor turns her apartment into a pond for her love of frogs, another transformed their place into a church devoted to blasphemy and a strange whispering machine whirs away in the basement.  You never know what to expect when you knock on a neighbor's door. 

Exploration and Secrets: The world changes and evolves as you play and is shaped by the choices you make. The deeper you explore, the more secrets you'll uncover. 

Collectables: As you explore the complex and it's surrounding areas, you'll uncover oddly shaped sponges that each have their own lively personality.

Unique Art Style: Warped perspectives, limited color palletes, original music and changing scenery all play a hand in shaping the strange experiences you'll discover behind closed doors. 

Metaphysical story and multiple playthroughs: WOODROT wears it's Lynchian inspirations on it's sleeve giving players the sense that there's always more than what's being said. The deeper you go, the more lore you'll discover. There are no easy answers. 

Passion Project: The entire game is made by two brothers. The artist and the programmer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This is a lightweight 2D game, but performance may vary on older hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 660 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: You're the maintenance man for an apartment complex that has mysteriously been transported to the middle of the ocean. Woodrot is a surreal adventure game about getting to know your neighbors who all seem to blame themselves for their recent relocation.
supported_languages:
English*, German*, Japanese*, Spanish - Latin America*
